events.title: The Great Fire of Rome breaks out
events.description: Fire broke out near the Circus Maximus and raged for days, gutting ten of Rome's fourteen districts. Rumour blamed Nero; Tacitus records that he blamed the Christians, beginning their first persecution.
events.html: Fire broke out near the Circus Maximus and raged for days, gutting ten of Rome's fourteen districts. Rumour blamed Nero; Tacitus records that he blamed the Christians, beginning their first persecution.

events.title: Edward I orders the expulsion of the Jews from England
events.description: Edward I issued the Edict of Expulsion, ordering all Jews to leave England by 1 November. Several thousand were forced out, and Jews were not readmitted until the Cromwellian era of the 1650s.
events.html: Edward I issued the Edict of Expulsion, ordering all Jews to leave England by 1 November. Several thousand were forced out, and Jews were not readmitted until the Cromwellian era of the 1650s.

events.title: The 54th Massachusetts leads the assault on Fort Wagner
events.description: The 54th Massachusetts, one of the first Black regiments in the Union army, led a night attack on Fort Wagner near Charleston. The assault failed with heavy losses, but the regiment's courage changed Northern opinion.
events.html: The 54th Massachusetts, one of the first Black regiments in the Union army, led a night attack on Fort Wagner near Charleston. The assault failed with heavy losses, but the regiment's courage changed Northern opinion.

events.title: The First Vatican Council defines papal infallibility
events.description: The council adopted Pastor aeternus, declaring the Pope free from error when he defines doctrine on faith or morals ex cathedra. The decree strengthened papal authority and caused a schism with the Old Catholics.
events.html: The council adopted Pastor aeternus, declaring the Pope free from error when he defines doctrine on faith or morals ex cathedra. The decree strengthened papal authority and caused a schism with the Old Catholics.

events.title: The first volume of Hitler's Mein Kampf is published
events.description: Hitler's autobiography and manifesto, written partly in prison, set out his antisemitism and his aim of conquering 'living space' in the east. Its ideas foreshadowed the policies of the Third Reich.
events.html: Hitler's autobiography and manifesto, written partly in prison, set out his antisemitism and his aim of conquering 'living space' in the east. Its ideas foreshadowed the policies of the Third Reich.

events.title: Military uprising launches the Spanish Civil War
events.description: Following the army revolt in Morocco the day before, garrisons across Spain rose against the Republic. The war lasted nearly three years and ended in General Franco's dictatorship.

intl.name: Nelson Mandela International Day
intl.description: Proclaimed by the United Nations in 2009 on the birthday of Nelson Mandela, this day invites individuals to devote 67 minutes of service to their communities — one minute for each year Mandela spent in public life.
